notes: Source for scripts/gen-art.mjs. Every prompt = stylePrefix + asset prompt + constraints. Write design/art-direction.md first, then copy its style lock into stylePrefix. Generate the anchor first; the other assets use it as a reference so they keep one style. Masters go to art/masters (git-ignored); copy the approved ones into apps/mobile/assets.
stylePrefix: Style: clean flat vector shapes with a soft inner glow, for a minimal portrait-mode mobile arcade game. Dark navy background family (#0E1116, #161B22). One cyan key color #4CC9F0 for the player, one magenta #F72585 for danger, one warm accent #FFD166 for rewards. Rounded corners, no outlines, gentle shading. Readable at 48 px.
constraints: Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no signature, no watermark, no frame or border. No likeness of a real person, a known character or the art of another game. Not photorealistic, not a 3D render.

assets.prompt: Style anchor sheet. A cyan rounded capsule paddle in the lower third. Three magenta rounded blocks of different widths falling above it. A dark navy field. Even spacing, centered composition.
Single sprite: the cyan rounded capsule paddle from the reference, seen from the front, centered, with a soft cyan glow. Nothing else in the image.
Single sprite: one magenta rounded block from the reference, centered, with a faint magenta glow. Nothing else in the image.
Empty arena backdrop for a portrait phone screen. Dark navy gradient with a very subtle grid and a soft vignette. Calm and low contrast, so sprites stay readable on top.
App icon. A cyan capsule paddle dodging one magenta block that falls past it, on a dark navy square. Bold and simple, readable at 60 px. Fill the whole square, no rounded mask.
